people.name: Mr. Kazunari Yamaguchi
people.evidence_quote: Mr. Kazunari Yamaguchi has resigned from the post of Whole-time Director designated as Director (Production) w.e.f. close of business hours of 30th September 2026.

people.name: Mr. Sarada Prasana Nayak

people.bio_quote: Mr. Sarada Prasana Nayak is responsible for chalking out business plan and strategies for complete manufacturing domain. This includes strategizing capacity expansion, l ean and efficient multi location plant operations, smart factory and sustainable operation.
